entries.en: Oof, got a fuckin’ shock, for real. But the job’s all done.
entries.ro: Oof, am luat un șoc de căcat, serios. Dar treaba e gata.

entries.en: You weren't supposed to touch it! I would've helped you. Whole mess of cables...
entries.ro: Nu trebuia să-l atingi! Te ajutam eu. Ce harababură de cabluri...

entries.en: Yeah, and it was pissing me off! Anyways, now we know whose cables are whose.
entries.ro: Da, și mă călca pe nervi! Oricum, acum știm ale cui sunt cablurile.
